SELECT account.id, account.username, account.name, account.phone, account.status, department.dept_name FROM sys_user account LEFT JOIN sys_dept department ON department.id = account.dept_id AND department.deleted = 0 WHERE account.deleted = 0 AND account.super_administrator = 0
AND account.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.username}, '%')
AND account.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.name}, '%')
AND account.status = 0 AND account.id != #{currentUserId}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role membership WHERE membership.role_id = #{query.roleId} AND membership.user_id = account.id ) ORDER BY account.create_time DESC, account.id DESC

SELECT r.id AS role_id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.data_scope FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0 INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
